meta.name: FIFA+
meta.description:
Bringing fans into the heart of football with the iconic World Cup Archive, Live football from around the globe and documentaries bring the stories behind the beautiful game.

Shows: FACTS: Spain v England | Australia/New Zealand 2023, FACTS: Italy v France | Germany 2006, Brazil v Mexico | Round of 16 | 2018 FIFA World Cup Russia™ | Full Match Replay, World Champions: France 1998, USA v Thailand | Group F | FIFA Women's World Cup France 2019™ | Full Match Replay
Available on: Samsung TV Plus, Plex
